source.japanese:
エド「倉庫は　アッシにまかせて
　ダンナは　冒険でもしてきてくだせえ！

entries.english: Ed: Leave the warehouse to me, guv'nor! Go have an adventure!

review.previous: Ed: Leave the warehouse to me, guv'nor! Go have an adventure!
review.reason: Preserves his assurance and request to go adventuring while he repairs the warehouse.

source.japanese:
エド「倉庫が完成して　ひさしぶりに
　いいアセかいたって感じでサア！

entries.english: Ed: Finishing the warehouse gave me a proper workout! First time in ages!

review.previous: Ed: Finishing the warehouse gave me a proper workout! First time in ages!
review.reason: Preserves completed construction and satisfaction at working up a good sweat for the first time in a while.

source.japanese:
エド「ダンナのうちの倉庫
　これで完全に　なおりやしたぜ！
エド「いやあ　おもったより
　かかりやしたね。

entries.english:
Ed: Your warehouse is completely fixed now, guv'nor!

Ed: Phew! That took longer than I thought.

review.previous:
Ed: Your warehouse is completely fixed now, guv'nor!

Ed: Phew! That took longer than I thought.
review.reason: Preserves complete repair and admission that it took longer than expected; no invented capacity.

source.japanese:
エド「ダンナ　できやしたぜ！
　これで　%-03{unclassified-control:64}コ　道具がおけやす。

entries.english:
Ed: All done, guv'nor!
You can now store {count} items.

review.previous:
Ed: All done, guv'nor!
You can now store {count} items.
review.reason: Preserves the actual native capacity substitution. English removes Japanese padded-field presentation but uses the original numeric value.

source.japanese:
エド「ただ　まだ完全に修理が
　おわったわけじゃあ　ねえんですよ。
エド「材料代が１０００ゴールドたまったら
　また　アッシに声をかけておくんなせえ。

entries.english:
Ed: Mind you, the repairs ain't finished yet.

Ed: Come see me again when you've saved another 1,000 gold for materials.

review.previous:
Ed: Mind you, the repairs ain't finished yet.

Ed: Come see me again when you've saved another 1,000 gold for materials.
review.reason: Preserves unfinished repairs, exact1000-gold material cost and request to return when saved; consistent Ed voice from the warehouse-opening scene.

source.japanese:
エド「ダンナ　じょうだんは
　いいっこなしですぜ！

entries.english: Ed: Come on, guv'nor! No foolin'!

review.previous: Ed: Come on, guv'nor! No foolin'!
review.reason: Preserves his incredulous response to claiming funds the player does not have, without inventing a payment or penalty.

source.japanese:
エド「あ　トルネコのダンナ！
　１０００ゴールド　できやしたか？

entries.english: Ed: Ah, Torneko, guv'nor! Have you got that 1,000 gold?

review.previous: Ed: Ah, Torneko, guv'nor! Have you got that 1,000 gold?
review.reason: Preserves Torneko by name, familiar address,1000 gold and the original yes/no sense.

source.japanese:
エド「わかりやした！

エド「それじゃあ　約束どおり
　倉庫をなおしておきやすよ！

entries.english:
Ed: Right you are!

Ed: I'll get that warehouse fixed up, just like I promised!

review.previous:
Ed: Right you are!

Ed: I'll get that warehouse fixed up, just like I promised!
review.reason: Preserves agreement and promise to repair the warehouse; future work is not claimed already complete.

source.japanese:
エド「わかりやした　ダンナ。

エド「おアシがそろったら
　アッシに　声をかけておくんなせえ。

entries.english:
Ed: All right, guv'nor.

Ed: Give me a shout once you've got the money together.

review.previous:
Ed: All right, guv'nor.

Ed: Give me a shout once you've got the money together.
review.reason: Preserves accepting the refusal and asking the player to return after raising the money.

scope: Nine original502BC warehouse-repair dialogue resources. Original branch flags,1000-gold payment and capacity changes are preserved. Existing shared formatter scratch is bounded to128 bytes; full prose is read directly from allocated ROM.
